name: valentine-pink-fashion-dreamy-girl
image_vibe: Dreamy playful Valentine editorial with soft pink styling and polished high-fashion detail
image_purpose: Create a romantic seasonal fashion portrait for Valentine campaign and lookbook use.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic Valentine fashion portrait of an original adult South Asian woman posing on a soft pink studio floor with a metallic heart balloon.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult South Asian woman with long wavy brown hair, elegant makeup, subtle smoky eyes, glossy lips, and a dreamy thoughtful expression. She wears a cropped light pink short-sleeve top, high-waisted wide-leg light pink jeans, and pointed pink slingback pumps. One hand holds a large metallic pink heart-shaped foil balloon while the other rests against her cheek.
prompt.composition_elements: Cute low squat pose with bent knees, subject centered on a soft warm pink studio background, metallic heart balloon and ribbon held to one side, balanced fashion-editorial framing, and clear separation between the pink outfit and backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft professional studio lighting, gentle highlights on the balloon and shoes, flattering skin tones, romantic Valentine atmosphere, polished cinematic color grading with coordinated pink tones.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic high-fashion photography, sharp fabric and balloon reflections, natural skin texture, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, controlled anatomy and footwear detail, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic romantic Valentine fashion portrait of an original adult South Asian woman with long wavy brown hair, elegant makeup, subtle smoky eyes, glossy lips, and a dreamy thoughtful expression. Pose her in a cute low squat with bent knees on a soft warm pink studio floor. Dress her in a cropped light pink short-sleeve top, high-waisted wide-leg light pink jeans, and pointed pink slingback pumps. Have one hand hold a large shiny metallic pink heart-shaped foil balloon with a long pink ribbon while the other rests against her cheek. Use soft professional studio lighting, realistic skin and fabric texture, controlled balloon reflections, cinematic pink color grading, high-fashion editorial polish, 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed balloon, broken ribbon, warped shoes, plastic skin, oversaturated pink, text, watermark

assets.name: source Valentine pink fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the pink palette, squat pose, heart balloon, outfit silhouette, and Valentine editorial mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult South Asian subject, pink fashion styling, heart balloon, thoughtful cheek gesture, soft pink studio, and romantic Valentine intent. Identity may vary.
